claims.claim: Borehole drilling machine for sale, sharp and working fine.
claims.evidence: Witness report describes a heavy-duty concrete mixer truck with a red concrete mixer drum and a boom/placing attachment with hoses/piping—no borehole drilling rig is described.

risks.risk: Item identity mismatch (seller claims borehole drilling machine, but witness sees a concrete mixer truck with pumping/placing attachment). This can mean you’re buying the wrong category of equipment.
risks.proof: A clear photo/video showing the full machine from multiple angles including any drilling mast/rig components (if it’s truly borehole drilling) OR clear branding/plate confirming it’s a concrete mixer/pump truck.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the witnessed item only (concrete mixer truck with boom/placing attachment) and treat it as unverified working condition until start-up and function are proven.

risks.risk: Engine/running condition unknown (no evidence it starts, idles, or drives properly).
risks.proof: Short video clip of cold start (or start-up), idle sound, and a slow drive/gear engagement in the yard.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst case as non-confirmed running/possibly needing engine work.

risks.risk: Mixer drum operation unknown (whether it rotates/mixes properly).
risks.proof: Video showing the mixer drum rotating and mixing (e.g., with water or test material) and confirming rotation speed/control.
risks.if_unproven: Price as mixer not proven (possible gearbox/motor/hydraulics issue).

risks.risk: Pumping/placing system condition unknown (pressure, valves, leaks).
risks.proof: Video of pump/boom operation: pressurizing lines, moving/placing action, and showing no leaks at hoses/valves during operation.
risks.if_unproven: Price as pump/placing system unproven and potentially leaking or weak.

risks.proof: Close-up photos of hydraulic hoses/cylinders plus a running clip showing hydraulic actuation without visible seepage.
risks.if_unproven: Price as hydraulic system may need replacement/repair.

risks.risk: Electrical/controls unknown (lights, indicators, wiring; control panel functionality).
risks.proof: Photo/video of dashboard/control panel with indicators working and all exterior lights functioning.
Photos of all tyres tread/sidewalls, brake test (if possible), and suspension/frame inspection shots.
risks.if_unproven: Price as tyres/brakes/suspension may require replacement.

risks.risk: Structural/attachment integrity unknown (frame/attachment welds, missing parts).
risks.proof: High-resolution close-ups of attachment framework welds, joints, and any wear points; plus underside shots.
risks.if_unproven: Price as structural condition unverified (possible repairs needed).

risks.risk: Documentation/ownership and roadworthiness unknown (papers, inspection status).
risks.proof: Photos of vehicle papers/ownership documents and any inspection/roadworthiness documents; VIN/chassis plate photo.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst case as documentation may be incomplete or problematic.

proof_requests: Confirm the exact item: send photos that clearly show whether it is a borehole drilling rig or a concrete mixer/pump truck (full machine, front, side, rear).
Provide a video of engine start-up, idle, and slow drive/gear engagement.
Provide a video showing the mixer drum rotating and mixing (test with water/material).
Provide a video of the pumping/placing system operating: pressurize lines, move boom/placing action, and show no leaks.
Send close-up photos of hydraulic hoses/cylinders and any control valves.
Send photos of tyres (all), brakes/suspension condition, and spare tyre availability.
Send close-up photos of attachment framework welds/joints and underside inspection.
Send photos of chassis/VIN plate, year/brand/model plate, and ownership/roadworthiness documents.
response.reason: The seller’s claim is contradicted by the witness report (borehole drilling vs concrete mixer truck with placing attachment). Even if we price the witnessed item, key proof needed to confirm working condition (start-up, mixer rotation, pump/boom operation) is missing, so a reliable worst-case price cannot be set without the missing shots.
